LanguageData.SLM_OnlyColonists_Desc: When enabled, multipliers and learning benefits only apply to player faction colonists and slaves, ignoring enemies, guests, and other pawns.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableDailyCap_Desc: In vanilla RimWorld, earning more than 4,000 XP in a single day reduces subsequent XP gains to 20%. Enabling this option removes this penalty so high multipliers are not throttled.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableSkillDecay_Desc: In vanilla RimWorld, skills at level 10 and above slowly lose XP over time. Enabling this option prevents skills from decaying.
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier: Use Global Multiplier for all skills
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier_Desc: When enabled, the single global multiplier applies to every skill. Uncheck to configure each skill independently.
LanguageData.SLM_IndividualNotice: Note: Global multiplier is currently active. Uncheck 'Use Global Multiplier' to use individual multipliers in-game.
